purpose: Explain the human listening observation 'drums stem sounds weird' with measured evidence
input: 45 s QQ Music capture (Core Audio process tap); ground truth from MUSDB18-HQ excerpts

qq_capture_stems.unit: dBFS RMS over the 45 s excerpt; spectral centroid over first 8 s
qq_capture_stems.reading: the drums stem is ~34 dB below the mixture, centered at 5.6 kHz with 62% of its energy in the top 2% samples: it is mostly faint high-frequency transient leakage, not drums. That is what the listener hears as '怪怪的'.

musdb_ground_truth.method: 3 test excerpts x 40 s; per-stem SDR of mask*mixture estimates vs true stems; 4 s windows
musdb_ground_truth.reading: drums SDR ~0 dB (no usable separation) and the drums estimate is 23-34 dB below the true drums; bass is over-allocated (negative SDR = worse than passing the mixture through), other/vocals are weak but positive.

stem_order_verified.method: 4x4 SDR matrix (model output stem index vs ground-truth stem) on one MUSDB excerpt
stem_order_verified.conclusion: diagonal is the best match for every row -> (vocals, drums, bass, other) stem order is correct; the drums problem is model quality, not a wiring/order bug.

checkpoint_training_state.reading: training stopped after 6 of 20 planned epochs (~14 min/epoch on MPS, loss still decreasing); the quarantine manifest already said 'training completion not independently established'. The drums stem is the weakest because the model is undertrained and capacity is small.

reference_point.industry_precedent_from_legacy_handoff: Band-SCNet 2.59M params, SDR 7.79 dB, 92 ms real-time; the corrected route was 'train a lightweight model from scratch', not distil htdemucs
reference_point.implication: a 0.55M/6-epoch checkpoint is below the credible quality class; the engineering chain is unaffected but the model is not product-ready

not_proven: no listening acceptance; this file explains the observed drums artifact, it does not judge audio quality
